title: Wellington crosses the Douro
episode: The Battle of Oporto - the Peninsular War saga
description: On the French invasion of 1809 and its end. On May 12, Wellington’s army crossed the Douro in wine barges and drove Marshal Soult’s troops out of Porto. Wellington directed the crossing from the Serra do Pilar monastery.

title: Eiffel, the bridge builder
show: Stuff You Missed in History Class
publisher: Stuff You Missed in History Class
description: On Gustave Eiffel’s career as an iron engineer, long before his tower. His firm built the Maria Pia railway bridge over the Douro, which opened in 1877 with what was then the longest iron arch in the world.

title: The story of azulejos
description: A tile restorer on azulejos, the painted tiles Portugal took from Moorish Spain and made its own. The Chapel of Souls on Rua de Santa Catarina is covered in about 16,000 of them, added in 1929.
